column3: ("The gods sacrificed with sacrifice. The gods sacrificed with Agni to Agni. 'Agni was the victim; they seized him and sacrificed with him'.")
column4: ಯಜ್ಞೇನ ಯಜ್ಞಮಯಜಂತ ದೇವಾಃ ... ಇತಿ ಚ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಂ (Sanskrit only, no translation)
column5: The English gives an English rendering of the Nirukta/Brāhmaṇa quotation, which the Kannada prints only in Sanskrit.

column3: ("They churn fire when King Soma has come. ... for Agni is the victim of the gods.")
column4: ಅಗ್ನಿಂ ಮಂಥಂತಿ ಸೋಮೇ ರಾಜನ್ಯಾಗತೇ ... ಅಗ್ನಿರ್ಹಿ ದೇವಾನಾಂ ಪಶುಃ (Sanskrit only, no translation)
column5: The English gives a full translation of the Aitareya Brāhmaṇa quotation, which the Kannada prints only in Sanskrit with no English rendering.

column3: ("Prajāpati meditated on the forms of Agni. ... I shall become unknown to him." — the parenthesised quotation rendering)
column4: ಪ್ರಜಾಪತಿರಗ್ನಿ ರೂಪಾಣ್ಯಭ್ಯಧ್ಯಾಯತ್ ... ಯನ್ಮ ಏಷ ನ ವೇದೇತಿ (Sanskrit only, no translation)
column5: The English gives a rendering of the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa quotation in parentheses; the Kannada gives only the Sanskrit (its later Kannada paraphrase is separate and is rendered correctly).
